title: IsingBlockNumerics: Certified finite-block influences for the square-lattice Ising model
description:
Reproducibility package for the Ising block-dynamics example in Rapid mixing of Gibbs samplers via quantum Dobrushin–Shlosman conditions, by Cambyse Rouzé and Daniel Stilck França.

An exhaustive transfer-matrix calculation with explicit roundoff bounds certifies positive Dobrushin–Shlosman margins for 6 × 6 blocks at βJ = 0.35 and 7 × 7 blocks at βJ = 0.36, while the single-site condition fails at both couplings. The package includes C++ and Python source, certified input weights, full coefficient tables and maximizing boundaries, independent small-block checks, plots, technical derivations, and conservative explicit perturbation-window calculations. These finite-block numerical certificates supply the classical reference for the quantum perturbation theorem in the companion manuscript.

The Python and C++ source code is licensed under MIT. Data, figures, and documentation are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as specified in LICENSE-DATA.md.
